exact_definition: UN Comtrade reference metadata identifies reporter code 620 as Portugal, but does not define the historical statistical territory.
methodological_note: reporterCode 620 is labelled Portugal; reporterNote Portugal; ISO alpha-3 PRT; isGroup false; entryEffectiveDate 1900-01-01.
reviewer_note: This is sufficient to identify the official code label but not sufficient to clear the reporter-territory block.

exact_definition: INE 1962 tables separate Ultramar Portugues from foreign countries and print special-trade totals by statistical territory.
evidence_source: INE Estatisticas do Comercio Externo 1962 Volume I
methodological_note: The introductory note says the statistical-territory list begins with Portuguese overseas territories and retains OECD/EEC/EFTA groupings; page 23 lists Ultramar Portugues separately.
reviewer_note: Supports the INE-side territory structure; does not by itself prove the Comtrade reporter scope.

exact_definition: Azores and Madeira have separately highlighted special-trade tables within metropolitan external trade reporting.
evidence_source: INE Estatisticas do Comercio Externo 1962 Volume I
methodological_note: The introductory note points to tables XII-XVII for Azores and Madeira imports/exports.
reviewer_note: This is a lead for resolving metropolitan Portugal versus adjacent-island treatment in later review.
